info.title: Agri-Market Intelligence Platform
info.description:
### Agri-Market Intelligence Platform API

High-throughput, offline-first digital marketplace backend powering:
- **Farmer & FPO Registry**: AgriStack KYC, land parcels, DPDP Act 2023 consents
- **Quality Assay AI**: Grain CV classification with tamper-evident HMAC signing
- **Mandi Price Intelligence**: Continuous AGMARKNET aggregations & TFT ML forecasting
- **Trade Execution**: Bilateral contracts, pledge finance, and warehouse liens
- **ONDC Integration**: BPP seller gateway, BAP LSP logistics quote aggregator & IGM grievances
- **Edge Synchronization**: WatermelonDB-compatible delta sync protocol for Kotlin Android clients

**Single Source of Truth Documentation**: See `docs/API_CONTRACT.md` and `SYNC_CONTRACT.md`.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User login, OAuth2 password flow, token refresh, RBAC role resolution, and client API key management.

tags.name: prices
tags.description: Real-time AGMARKNET mandi feeds, continuous rollups, modal price statistics, and ML-powered multi-horizon forecasting.

tags.name: farmers
tags.description: Farmer profile registry, land parcel boundaries, crop records, bank details, and localized KYC management.

tags.name: consents
tags.description: DPDP Act 2023 compliant consent artifacts, digital signatures, revocations, and audit logging.

tags.name: agristack
tags.description: Direct integration with India AgriStack registries (Farmer ID, Land Registry, Georeferenced plots).

tags.name: lots
tags.description: Commodity lot creation, inventory tracking, quality status lifecycle (UNASSAYED -> ASSAYED -> LISTED -> LOCKED -> SOLD).

tags.name: trades
tags.description: Bilateral trade contract execution, counter-negotiations, escrow settlement triggers, and dispute holds.

tags.name: sync
tags.description: WatermelonDB-compatible bidirectional offline-first sync protocol for low-connectivity Android field devices.

tags.name: events
tags.description: Transactional outbox events, event replay, and streaming relay status.

tags.name: finance
tags.description: Electronic Negotiable Warehouse Receipt (e-NWR) pledge loans, LTV assessment, lien registration, and repayments.

tags.name: telemetry
tags.description: Per-FPO NATS JetStream telemetry, IoT sensor queues, edge heartbeats, and backpressure metrics.

tags.name: logistics
tags.description: PostGIS haulage routing, cold-chain tariff computation, vehicle profiles, and ONDC LSP network quote aggregation.

tags.name: logistics_webhooks
tags.description: Asynchronous ONDC LSP webhook ingestion for tracking updates, proof-of-delivery, and carrier status.

tags.name: grievances
tags.description: ONDC Issue & Grievance Management (IGM) tickets, respondent actions, escalation workflows, and resolutions.

tags.name: ratings
tags.description: Two-sided trust ratings and reviews for farmers, FPOs, logistics providers, and institutional buyers.

tags.name: assay-ai
tags.description: Computer vision quality inspection, grain defect detection, moisture grading, and tamper-evident HMAC signing.

tags.name: admin-lgd
tags.description: Local Government Directory (LGD) reconciliation, mandi code resolution, state/district/sub-district mapping.

tags.name: beckn
tags.description: ONDC Beckn protocol BPP (Seller) endpoints: discovery, order lifecycle, tracking, and cancellation callbacks.

tags.name: beckn_bap
tags.description: ONDC Beckn protocol BAP (Buyer) client querying external logistics service providers (LSPs) and partner networks.

tags.name: health
tags.description: Kubernetes liveness, readiness, and startup health probes with downstream dependency health checks.
